role: Postoutcome exploratory RGFCA-only diagnostic. It supersedes the flower-only omnibus v1 for interpretation before any v1 scientific permutation outcome existed. It is not a sharedness test and cannot reclassify G1, G3, environmental tests, or any prior frozen decision.

supersedes.reason: The flower-only coordinate-shuffle null destroys all spatial structure and therefore cannot distinguish flower-specific spatial organization from geographically structured illumination, camera, scene, phenology, observer, or other image-level nuisances.
supersedes.preoutcome_guard: Workflow runs 34085753211 and 34085861343 terminated before any species observed/null omnibus statistic was produced: run 1 failed in tests; run 2 passed tests but every shard stopped at Python import before loading the measured frame or computing a species statistic.

main_line_firewall.scientific_main_question: cross-species sharedness of flower-colour transition structure

matched_frame.purpose: Diagnose the already-existing G3/old-omnibus 369-species frame, not choose the RGFCA-v2 acquisition denominator.
matched_frame.selection_rule: Exactly the previously frozen global_classifiable photographs belonging to species with at least 40 classifiable photographs. No threshold or species set may be changed after background recovery.

background_recovery.source_image_rule: Reacquire the exact same photo_id through the frozen candidate photo_url_large only; no replacement or alternative observation is permitted.
background_recovery.exact_image_identity_required: Every reacquired image used in the diagnostic must have SHA256 exactly equal to the image_sha256 stored by the original blinded measurement. A mismatch is not a usable control photograph.
background_recovery.roi_runtime: Frozen ROI-v4 detector plus EfficientSAM used in the original global measurement.
background_recovery.background_mask: The already-frozen ROI-v4 _background_annulus: union of each detector box expanded by 25% in width and height, minus the unexpanded detector boxes and minus the flower mask.
reproduction_guards: recomputed flower palette_count_* for all twelve frozen anchors must exactly equal the originally stored flower palette counts for every used photo
recomputed background_effective_pixels must exactly equal the originally stored background_effective_pixels for every used photo
the original image SHA256 must match before any recovered background colour is admitted
background_recovery.failure_rule: If exact matched recovery is incomplete, report the predetermined recovery failure and do not silently replace photos, lower a species threshold, or select a successful subset for the primary diagnostic.

matched_colour_representation.reason_for_twelve_anchor_control: The original four biological groups explicitly discard green, brown and black. Applying that flower-specific denominator to leaves/background would erase much of the negative-control signal. Therefore flower and background are compared symmetrically using the already-frozen full twelve-anchor palette, with no new colour axis fitted from outcomes.
matched_colour_representation.pixel_assignment: nearest frozen sRGB palette anchor in CIELAB, exactly as photo_first_measurement.nearest_palette_counts
matched_colour_representation.vector: twelve palette counts normalized by all pixels in that mask; no nuisance anchor is dropped
matched_colour_representation.pairwise_dissimilarity: Jensen-Shannon divergence using base-2 logarithms, identical formula for flower and background vectors

species_statistic.name: distance_differential_colour_spearman_rho
species_statistic.definition: For every unordered photo pair within a species compute D_ij = JSD(flower12_i, flower12_j) - JSD(background12_i, background12_j), then Spearman-correlate great-circle geographic distance with D_ij.
species_statistic.motivation: A positive statistic means flower dissimilarity increases with geographic separation more strongly than matched local-background dissimilarity on the same photographs.

primary_global_statistic.name: equal_species_mean_differential_rho
primary_global_statistic.definition: Arithmetic mean of the 369 species differential rho values, equal weight per species regardless of photo or pair count.

joint_exact_randomization_null.procedure: Within each species and permutation, jointly permute each photograph's paired (flower12 vector, background12 vector) across the species' fixed coordinates. The flower/background pair from one photograph always moves together.
preserves: the complete within-species multiset of flower vectors
the complete within-species multiset of background vectors
the exact same-photo association between flower and background vectors
joint_exact_randomization_null.global_null_statistic: Recompute every species differential rho and the equal-species mean differential rho for the same permutation index.
joint_exact_randomization_null.p_value: (1 + number of 999 null global statistics >= observed global statistic) / 1000

mandatory_secondary_controls: equal-species mean Spearman rho for geographic distance versus flower12 JSD
equal-species mean Spearman rho for geographic distance versus background12 JSD
species distributions of flower rho, background rho, and differential rho

interpretation_gate.if_primary_supported: May be described only as postoutcome exploratory evidence that flower colour has a geographic-distance association exceeding matched local-background colour structure under the frozen twelve-anchor diagnostic. It remains neither a sharedness result nor a causal/environmental mechanism result.
interpretation_gate.if_primary_unsupported: The flower-only within-species omnibus is not biologically interpretable as evidence of flower-specific spatial organization and must not be promoted as an RGFCA main result.
interpretation_gate.if_background_mean_rho_is_comparable_to_: Explicitly report that scene/background geographic colour structure is sufficient to challenge the flower-only interpretation even if a flower-only shuffle test would be positive.

claim_ceiling: Negative-control diagnostic for whether the old RGFCA within-species distance-colour tendency exceeds matched same-photo background colour structure. The RGFCA scientific main line remains sharedness and its acquisition/design-power problem.
